시편-112-1.title: 시편 112장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-112-1.exegesis: 10. And hence love and fear of such a God is the chief element of true wisdom (compare Pr 1:7 ; 9:10 ).
시편-112-1.theologicalNote: 10. And hence love and fear of such a God is the chief element of true wisdom (compare Pr 1:7 ; 9:10 ).

시편-112-2.title: 시편 112장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-112-2.exegesis: PSALM 112 Psa 112:1-10 . This Psalm may be regarded as an exposition of Psa 111:10 , presenting the happiness of those who fear and obey God, and contrasting the fate of the ungodly. 1. True fear produces obedience and this happiness.
시편-112-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 112 Psa 112:1-10 . This Psalm may be regarded as an exposition of Psa 111:10 , presenting the happiness of those who fear and obey God, and contrasting the fate of the ungodly. 1. True fear produces obedience and this happiness.

시편-112-3.title: 시편 112장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-112-3.exegesis: 2-3. Temporal blessings follow the service of God, exceptions occurring only as they are seen by God to be inconsistent with those spiritual blessings which are better.
시편-112-3.theologicalNote: 2-3. Temporal blessings follow the service of God, exceptions occurring only as they are seen by God to be inconsistent with those spiritual blessings which are better.

시편-112-5.title: 시편 112장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-112-5.exegesis: 4. light-- figurative for relief ( Psa 27:1 ; 97:11 ). the upright-- are like God ( Lu 6:36 ; Psa 111:4 ).
시편-112-5.theologicalNote: 4. light-- figurative for relief ( Psa 27:1 ; 97:11 ). the upright-- are like God ( Lu 6:36 ; Psa 111:4 ).

시편-112-6.title: 시편 112장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-112-6.exegesis: 5-9. Generosity, sound judgment in business, and confidence in God, form a character which preserves from fear of evil and ensures success against enemies. While a man thus truly pious is liberal, he increases in substance.
시편-112-6.theologicalNote: 5-9. Generosity, sound judgment in business, and confidence in God, form a character which preserves from fear of evil and ensures success against enemies. While a man thus truly pious is liberal, he increases in substance.
